title: 035 - Error Message Priority
prompt: Fix the bug so the program print the first non-empty error message and prints exactly `Name required`. Keep the sample data and do not add extra output.
brokenCode:
<?php

function errorMessagePriority(array $values): string
{
    sort($values);
    return implode(",", $values);
}
solutionCode:
<?php

function errorMessagePriority(array $values): string
{
    rsort($values);
    return implode(",", $values);
}
hint: The fallback should only be used when every error message is empty.
explanation: The broken code jumps to the fallback too early. Returning the first non-empty message fixes the priority order.
